Matrix recurrence, dominant-root constant, and finite checks agree. Finite enumeration is corroboration, not infinite proof.

value.rationale: The natural degree-parity/cycle-parity obstruction explains global suppression of oscillations on whole families of odd-cycle cactus networks despite general majority systems allowing two-cycles. The exact cubic all-length fixed-state law on triangular chains gives a previously nonimplied natural invariant and entropy constant, separating guaranteed eventual stabilization from exponentially rare initially fixed configurations. Not a mere single finite count or substitution.
